section1.p: This document describe a way for entities to manipulate and share &xep0060; nodes Bookmarks with other entities.
It completes &xep0465; that focuses only on sharing publicly Pubsub suscriptions by defining a common &subscription; element that can be listed in different configuration such as in &xep0503;.

This document also defines &xep0163; node qualified by the 'urn:xmpp:subscription' namespace. If an entity wishes to publish some Pubsub Nodes Bookmarks publicly available then the entity MAY publish them on this node.
This specification and &xep0465; are meant to be used conjointly.

Clients store each bookmarked Pubsub node as a Pubsub item within the 'urn:xmpp:subscription' node. Each item SHALL have, as item id, the Pubsub URI of the node (eg, pubsub.shakespeare.lit?;node=princely_musings see &xep0060;#impl-uri).
The payload of the item SHALL be a &subscription; element qualified by the 'urn:xmpp:pubsub:subscription:1' namespace, with the following syntax:

tr.td: A friendly name for the bookmark, specified by the user. Clients SHOULD NOT attempt to autogenerate this from the JID.

A set of child elements (of potentially any namespace). Clients MUST preserve these (particularly preserving unknown elements) when editing items. Compatible with the <extensions/> element defined in &xep0402;

section1.p: The motivations for this document are to:

ul.li: Allow Jabber user's to share their &xep0060; subscriptions
Add a new way to discover &xep0060; nodes

di.dd: A simplified subset of Publish-Subscribe for use in the context of instant messaging and presence applications, whereby each IM user's JID is a virtual pubsub service; for details, see Personal Eventing Protocol.

section2.topic: Adding a subscription to the list

example.caption: Add a subscription to the list

section2.example: <iq type="set" from="juliet@capulet.lit/balcony" id="sub123"> <pubsub xmlns="http://jabber.org/protocol/pubsub"> <publish node="urn:xmpp:pubsub:subscription"> <item id="pubsub.shakespeare.lit?;node=princely_musings"> <subscription xmlns="urn:xmpp:pubsub:subscription:1" title="Party at the Capulets"/> </item> </publish> </pubsub> </iq>

section2.topic: Removing a subscription from the list

example.caption: Remove a subscription from the list

section2.topic: Modifiying a subscription of the list

example.caption: Change the information of a subscription of the list

section2.example: <iq type='set' from='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony' id='unsub1'> <pubsub xmlns='http://jabber.org/protocol/pubsub'> <publish node='urn:xmpp:pubsub:subscription'> <item id='pubsub.shakespeare.lit?;node=princely_musings'> <subscription xmlns='urn:xmpp:pubsub:subscription:1'> <extensions> <pinned xmlns='urn:xmpp:bookmarks-pinning:0'/> </extensions> </subscription> </item> </publish> </pubsub> </iq>

section1.p: The title attribute of a &subscription; item SHOULD be in the same language as the contents of the node in question.
The publication of user tune information is not known to introduce any new security considerations above and beyond those defined in XEP-0060: Publish-Subscribe.
This document requires no interaction with &IANA;.
The ®ISTRAR; is requested to issue an initial namespace of "urn:xmpp:pubsub:subscription".
